== Actual Decipher documentary source and physical-card inheritance ==
The final [[:File:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Decipher Glossary Supplement]], cover updated 29 January 2002, page 5, prints a “Kessel (Dark Side)” entry replacing only the Dark text. Actual entry: [[File:Kessel-Dark-Decipher-Supplement-2002-p5-entry.png|frameless|300px]]. It supplies the Tarkin-aboard-a-starship and Kessel Run canceled wording. It does not print a Light clause, destiny/deploy stats, a full-card face, or D-E1. The actual original physical [[:File:Premiere-D-kessel-hires.webp]] independently supplies the unchanged Light ability-6 clause, parsec 8, both sets of Force/planet icons and title/uniqueness. Destiny 0 is retained as a rule-derived Location value: the actual Decipher Glossary (1998), PDF page 84, and Advanced Rulebook (2023), PDF page 83, explicitly give all locations destiny zero. Both sources also say locations have no deploy cost and deploy for free (Glossary page 84; Advanced Rulebook page 84). Free deployment is explained in prose; no printed deploy-cost box is invented. See [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|original rules]] and [[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|current rules]]. The gold E [[:File:Premiere-D-kessel-errata-hires.webp]] is an explicitly credited fan rendition; its automatic High-Res Scan association is detached while the file/TIFF/credit are preserved. Existing <code>1_288</code>, all navigation, gameplay wording, strategy and unrelated prose remain unchanged. No official PC ordinal is added. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).
